_meta.purpose: Small curated reference dataset. Not a facility directory.

hazard_classes.routine: Ordinary stream; recovery can be investigated directly.
hazard_classes.regulated: Regulated stream; recovery and disposal only through authorized channels. No do-it-yourself processing.
hazard_classes.unknown_high_risk: Unidentified or high-risk material; recovery is blocked until a qualified person identifies it.

evidence_levels.regulation_pointer: Backed by a named public rule or authority (clauses not verified by this project).
evidence_levels.general_practice: Widely described practice; check local availability and suitability.

materials.name: Agricultural residue (crop straw, husk, stubble, bagasse)

recovery_options.option: In-situ management (incorporate or manage residue in the field using suitable machinery)
recovery_options.compatibility: Depends on crop, soil moisture and the time before the next sowing.
uncertainties: Machinery availability and any subsidy schemes differ by state and year.
recovery_options.next_step: Ask the district agriculture office or nearest KVK which machinery and schemes are currently available.

recovery_options.option: Ex-situ use (collect and supply to biomass users such as pellet, briquette or energy units)
recovery_options.compatibility: Needs bales or loose residue with low moisture and a nearby buyer.
recovery_options.professional_processing: Baling equipment and an off-taker that accepts the residue.
uncertainties: No buyer is verified by this app.
Price and demand vary by season and location.
recovery_options.next_step: Ask the local agriculture office for the names of currently operating residue buyers, then confirm with each directly.

recovery_options.option: Composting or mulching (hypothesis for small quantities)
recovery_options.compatibility: Better for small quantities of clean residue with no chemical contamination.
recovery_options.professional_processing: None for small quantities; larger volumes need planning and space.
uncertainties: Suitability varies by crop type and the climate.
recovery_options.next_step: Confirm suitability with a KVK before committing large volumes.

disposal_pathways.pathway: Do not burn in the open. Use one of the recovery routes or the local municipal or agricultural collection arrangement.
disposal_pathways.authority: Local agriculture office / State Pollution Control Board
uncertainties: Open-burning rules and penalties are set locally; confirm the current rule for your state.
disposal_pathways.next_step: Check your state's current rule on crop residue burning with the district agriculture office.

recovery_options.option: Reuse or refurbishment through a registered refurbisher or a manufacturer or retailer program
recovery_options.compatibility: Working or repairable devices only; data must be wiped by the owner first.
uncertainties: Whether a registered refurbisher operates near you is NOT verified by this app.
recovery_options.next_step: Look up registered entities on the CPCB site or ask the device's producer about its take-back option.

recovery_options.option: Material recovery through a registered e-waste recycler
recovery_options.compatibility: Non-working devices and accessories; recyclers decide what they accept.
uncertainties: Acceptance of a specific item or quantity is NOT verified by this app.
recovery_options.next_step: Contact a recycler from the official registered list and confirm what it accepts before transporting anything.

disposal_pathways.pathway: Hand over to a producer take-back point or an authorized e-waste collection channel. Do not dismantle, burn or dump.
disposal_pathways.authority: Producer / registered collector or recycler; regulator is CPCB and the State Pollution Control Board
uncertainties: No specific collection point is verified by this app.
disposal_pathways.next_step: Find authorized collection points through the producer or the State Pollution Control Board.

recovery_options.option: Return through the producer or an authorized battery collection and recycling channel
recovery_options.compatibility: Intact batteries; damaged, swollen or leaking batteries need professional handling.
uncertainties: Whether a particular recycler accepts your battery type and quantity is NOT verified by this app.
recovery_options.next_step: Ask the battery's seller or producer about take-back, or use the official registered list.

disposal_pathways.pathway: Use producer take-back or an authorized collection point. Do not open, puncture, burn or throw in general waste.
disposal_pathways.authority: Producer / authorized collector; regulator is CPCB and the State Pollution Control Board
uncertainties: No specific collection point is verified by this app.
disposal_pathways.next_step: Ask the seller or producer, or check the State Pollution Control Board for authorized collectors.

materials.name: Used oil (engine, gear or hydraulic oil)

recovery_options.option: Re-refining or other recovery by an authorized used-oil recycler
recovery_options.compatibility: Used oil kept separate from solvents, water and other waste is generally easier to recover; the recycler decides acceptance.
uncertainties: Whether an authorized recycler serves your area is NOT verified by this app.
Contaminated oil may be refused or handled differently.
recovery_options.next_step: Ask the State Pollution Control Board for authorized used-oil recyclers and confirm acceptance and transport before moving the oil.

disposal_pathways.pathway: Hand over only to an authorized used-oil handler. Never pour on ground or into drains, and do not burn.
disposal_pathways.authority: Authorized recycler; regulator is the State Pollution Control Board
uncertainties: No specific handler is verified by this app.
disposal_pathways.next_step: Keep the oil in its sealed, labelled container and contact the State Pollution Control Board for authorized handlers.

materials.name: Unknown or unlabelled chemical waste
materials.category: Unknown or potentially hazardous chemical waste

disposal_pathways.pathway: Do not handle, open, mix, move or test the contents. Keep people away and refer to the State Pollution Control Board or a qualified hazardous-waste professional for identification and authorized handling.
disposal_pathways.authority: State Pollution Control Board; qualified hazardous-waste professional; local emergency services if there is immediate danger
uncertainties: The contents are unknown, so no recovery or treatment route can be assessed.
disposal_pathways.next_step: Contact the State Pollution Control Board or a qualified professional and describe what you can see from a safe distance.
